slices.focus: Nina nudges Colleen into a Saturday morning walking group, providing restorative social time that asks nothing of her professionally.
slices.summary: With things slightly steadier, Colleen joins a small neighborhood walking group near the Italian Market. The appeal is that it's tiny, local, and makes no demands. Nina's role shifts from practical sounding board to also nudging Colleen toward restorative routines. Colleen commits to treating Saturday morning as a default (not a reward), protecting the slot lightly, and letting a manageable connection grow at its own pace.
open_loops: Keeping Saturday morning as default, not reward -- protecting it from being eaten by errands
Coffee every other time as a gentle social deepening
Noticing post-walk effect on the rest of the weekend
